theorem branch1_paper_formula {n : ℤ} (p : DirectDomain1 n) :
    2 * (branch1Equiv n p).rep.1.x =
        p.rep.1.x + 2 * p.rep.1.z - p.rep.1.y ∧
      (branch1Equiv n p).rep.1.y = p.rep.1.x - 2 * p.rep.1.z ∧
      8 * (branch1Equiv n p).rep.1.z =
        p.rep.1.x + 2 * p.rep.1.z + p.rep.1.y

      8 * (branch2Equiv n p).rep.1.z =

    dot (linComb3 a b t F.e₁ F.e₂ F.z)
      (linComb3 a b t F.e₁ F.e₂ F.z) =
      dot F.e₁ F.e₁ * a ^ 2 +
      2 * (dot F.e₁ F.e₂ * b + t * dot F.z F.e₁) * a +
      dot F.e₂ F.e₂ * b ^ 2 +
      2 * t * dot F.z F.e₂ * b + t ^ 2 * dot F.z F.z

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.gram_cubic_identity
statement:
theorem gram_cubic_identity :
    let α := dot F.e₁ F.e₁
    let β := dot F.e₁ F.e₂
    let γ := dot F.e₂ F.e₂
    let δ := dot F.z F.e₁
    let ε := dot F.z F.e₂
    let ζ := dot F.z F.z
    α * γ * ζ + 2 * β * δ * ε - α * ε ^ 2 - γ * δ ^ 2 - β ^ 2 * ζ = 1

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.short_identity_aux
statement:
theorem short_identity_aux :
    let α := dot F.e₁ F.e₁
    let β := dot F.e₁ F.e₂
    let δ := dot F.z F.e₁
    let ε := dot F.z F.e₂
    let ζ := dot F.z F.z
    let n := dot p p
    let K := β * δ - α * ε
    K ^ 2 + n * (δ ^ 2 - α * ζ) = -α

      dot e₁ e₁ * dot z e₂ ^ 2 -

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.halfDiscriminant_nonneg_iff_interval
statement:
theorem halfDiscriminant_nonneg_iff_interval
    {n A q b : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) (hpNorm : dot p p = n)
    (hAM :
      0 ≤ dot F.e₁ F.e₁ * (A * (n - q ^ 2 * A))) :
    let α := dot F.e₁ F.e₁
    let β := dot F.e₁ F.e₂
    let δ := dot F.z F.e₁
    let ε := dot F.z F.e₂
    let t := q * A
    let K := β * δ - α * ε
    let M := A * (n - q ^ 2 * A)
    0 ≤ F.halfDiscriminant A q b ↔
      ⌈((t * K - Int.sqrt (α * M) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (n : ℚ)⌉ ≤ b ∧
        b ≤ ⌊((t * K + Int.sqrt (α * M) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (n : ℚ)⌋

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.short_interval_identity
statement:
theorem short_interval_identity (A q b : ℤ) :
    let α := dot F.e₁ F.e₁
    let β := dot F.e₁ F.e₂
    let δ := dot F.z F.e₁
    let ε := dot F.z F.e₂
    let n := dot p p
    let t := q * A
    let K := β * δ - α * ε
    let M := A * (n - q ^ 2 * A)
    n * F.halfDiscriminant A q b = α * M - (n * b - t * K) ^ 2

name: TunnellMap.square_le_iff_mem_floorCeilInterval

      ⌈((c - Int.sqrt X : ℤ) : ℚ) / (n : ℚ)⌉ ≤ b ∧
        b ≤ ⌊((c + Int.sqrt X : ℤ) : ℚ) / (n : ℚ)⌋

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.affineQuadratic_discriminant
statement:
theorem affineQuadratic_discriminant (A q b : ℤ) :
    let α := dot F.e₁ F.e₁
    let β := dot F.e₁ F.e₂
    let γ := dot F.e₂ F.e₂
    let δ := dot F.z F.e₁
    let ε := dot F.z F.e₂
    let ζ := dot F.z F.z
    let t := q * A
    quadraticHalfDiscriminant α (β * b + t * δ)
      (γ * b ^ 2 + 2 * t * ε * b + t ^ 2 * ζ - A) =
        F.halfDiscriminant A q b

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.affine_norm_eq_iff

    dot (linComb3 a b (q * A) F.e₁ F.e₂ F.z)
        (linComb3 a b (q * A) F.e₁ F.e₂ F.z) = A ↔
      F.affineQuadratic A q a b = 0

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.affine_norm_root_certificate
statement:
theorem affine_norm_root_certificate (A q a b : ℤ) :
    dot (linComb3 a b (q * A) F.e₁ F.e₂ F.z)
        (linComb3 a b (q * A) F.e₁ F.e₂ F.z) = A ↔
      ∃ u : ℤ,
        u ^ 2 = F.halfDiscriminant A q b ∧
        dot F.e₁ F.e₁ * a =
          -(dot F.e₁ F.e₂ * b + q * A * dot F.z F.e₁) + u
